scene: The dragon lantern springs to life, lighting a multi-platform transit hub.
picture: Flat pixel-art side view. On the far left, a green water taxi bobs at a dock. In the centre, the elderly East Asian man in his blue cap and orange cardigan holds his cane, smiling. To his right sits a yellow monorail car at a platform gate, and far right waits a red funicular carriage.
shown: a green water taxi bobbing beside a low wooden dock on the far left
a sleek yellow monorail car idling at an open platform gate on the right
a red glass-topped funicular carriage waiting on slanted rails on the far right
